description: Tiva_à vélo - Location de vélos longue durée - Intercom de la Vire au Noireau 2025 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Intercom de la Vire au Noireau. Intercom de la Vire au Noireau offers its residents the opportunity to discover the VAE by renting an electric bike for a period of one month or one quarter. Contracts are renewable. Coverage: Intercom de la Vire au Noireau. The portal shows the English title as "Tiva_à vélo - Long-term bike rental - Intercom de la Vire au Noireau 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Intercom de la Vire au Noireau. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
